svg.aria-label: TRM workflow: an administrator launches the batch; for every topic of a cluster the pipeline expands the topic into queries, retrieves the publications of the laboratories' members from the knowledge graph, verifies each candidate with the LLM, scores and writes JSON, Markdown and PDF reports
svg.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Asynchronous: every topic of a cluster, unattended, about 25 s per topic, reports as files

text.tspan: “read the topic, write queries that read like the titles of the
publications a relevant researcher would have written — no policy
wording; add the terms a researcher would use, in English and French”

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Verification prompt (step 3, one call per candidate)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: “judge only from the listed publications (found by semantic search,
some unrelated); be strict: relevant only if the subject overlaps the
research content; give a verdict and a two-sentence justification”
